name: agent-session-world
title_zh: 编程会话变成一座会自己动的 3D 小世界
tagline_zh: 每个对话线程变成一只居民，每个项目变成它住的地方，线程在忙什么就决定它在干什么——月亮上的小机器人、礁石间的鱼。
tagline_en: Each thread becomes an inhabitant, each project its habitat, and what the thread is doing decides what it does.
desc_en: Build someone a living 3D world out of their own coding-agent sessions, in whatever form they ask for — little robots on a moon, fish in a reef, animals in a forest, villagers, ants, boats in a harbour. Each thread becomes an inhabitant, each project becomes somewhere for them to live, and what a thread is really doing decides what its inhabitant does. This skill supplies the structure that makes
why_zh: 它给的不是贴图，是一套结构：线程状态映射到居民行为，所以世界会随你的实际工作自己变。
why_en: Not decoration — a structure mapping thread state to inhabitant behavior, so the world shifts as your real work does.
limit_zh: 只认能读到会话记录的环境，读不到就只剩空场景；形态靠你指定，不指定它不会替你挑；产物是观赏用的世界。
limit_en: Needs readable session logs, or you get an empty scene; you must name the form yourself; output is view-only, nothing written back to code or tasks.
title_en: Your coding sessions, rebuilt as a living 3D world
